name: Native USB Names
author: NachoCasta
summary: Native USB names with volume-label fallback.
description: Preserves rekordbox device names exactly. Unnamed native USB sources show their volume label, retaining native icons, colors and USB identity. Presentation only; no disk renaming or hub dependency. Exact firmware 2.00 ep147-9e9454e357389ece, kernel 4.4.194; core 1.2.3 or newer. Physical testing pending.
